authority_note: PentaScribe may federate existing canonical identities from registered sources, but federation does not create legal/trademark/provider authority and does not promote unknown candidates.

equivalences.reason: The compact PentaScribe seed identifier and PentaOS machine key refer to the same canonical PentaScribe system identity.
The compact PentaMarketer seed identifier and PentaOS machine key refer to the same canonical PentaMarketer system identity.

PentaBind is one canonical binding identity expressed both as a first-class PentaOS interoperation component and as the PentaRoute binding primitive. The dual role does not create separate legal, provider, credential, or governance identities.
